tooling: hand-written; attached to every release image by .github/workflows/release.yml (cosign attest --type openvex)

vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained, unsafe by design, and has known security issues

statements.impact_statement: The advisory covers only the golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp packages. No binary of the image (/api, /worker, /clab) or of the clab CLI imports them: govulncheck in source mode finds no reachable or imported symbol, and none of the openpgp packages is linked into the binaries. Scanners that match by module version (govulncheck -mode=binary, Trivy, Grype) report it because the module golang.org/x/crypto is present for other packages.
